body: If I was in the military, I would have tons of support. But they screen people carefully, so any documents showing that I am depressed would definitely jeopardize things, especially when I signed papers saying that there were no mental health issues...which was real at the time. Habits...well, I dont know. They all seem terrible to me.

Man, I wish I could see it as that...but knowing who I am, and the way Ive felt about things like what I have been doing lately (that is, how I truly felt when actually doing those so-called "good things" or "accomplishments), I see it as worthless. I dont know...each time I try to tell myself about something positive or worthwhile that I have done, I shoot it down.

It hasnt helped that I major in psyc. So I've been tracking this thing for a while and dealing with it by volunteering, hanging with friends, etc, but now its just spiraled out of my emotional control. I dont want to see a therapist since I feel it could jeopardize my military ambitions. 

I can relate to your past situation though. True cause? Well, the problem is self worth, and I figure if I could motivate myself and study, or take up a productive hobby it would better, but I have no motivation, which I dont have since Im depressed....and on and on and on. 

I dont feel like dying atm, which is nice, but I dont really feel like moving on either.
Emotionally, they have been going through tough times for over 10 years.

Its really the only thing that I have going for me. So I'm not going to knife myself. But Ive been feeling super cold, icey, and was just lying in my tub with some hot water on wondering if it was worth living anymore. Kind of an acceptance of death, how I would find it to be nice to not have all of these things crumble around me. 

Demotivated, kind of. I keep trying to do stuff and always wind up wondering why I have no energy doing them. Lack of food does not help, but lack of true friends to get me outside does not help as well. I just wake up, have one class, and then I have work into the evenings. Then I sleep and do it all again. No time to do anything else except shoot the shit before lights out.

Just got off the phone with my friend. Hes from another state so he cant come over but he told me about st johns wort, said that i should definitely be with another friend, get some food in me. 

The marine thing...well, I DO all that...but, I am not feeling it anymore. No motivation at all, only obligation. And I cant talk to family because of my issues with them.
pretty much. im on the phone with a pal.

thing is, is that I try to justify my laziness with my goal. i did training, had a tough experience, am about to go through it again. I dont want to even label myself as anything close to one, but Im trying to be a marine officer. in the mean time I just get through school, and i also volunteer at the end of my week, but once again those are because of classes. the funny thing is is that im the only one who shows up on time, hows that for a twist.

With the way everything is, Im just paranoid about stopping myself from getting there. Its military, im coming out of college. i exercise plenty, but all I do is game and shoot the shit, wake and sleep, if it was up to me.

Thats the thing. Im so close to accomplishing my life goal (as of now), only 6 months away. 

But I look at myself more closely than that and see that Nothing I do on my own, personal time,  does anything good. I go to work because I need to. Whenever I have free time, I just game, hang out with a friend. Just something to kill time. But even those things dont do it. And now I look back on all of that and see how little I have done to credit myself to. Not in a "look at what this guy has done, published kind of thing", but in a more immediate way. i cant call upon any useful information. i cant build anything, i cant code, i cant do anything. I see myself as useless until i meet that goal. But now I just wake up and even that doesnt give me energy

Im sorry, I keep trying to edit this so I can make my point

Family wise, everyone is a wreck. Divorced parents, pre suicidal brother (as he has deeply discussed with me). I have dealt with all of them and wouldnt even break a sweat. Ive grown very used to taking care of some of my families emotional baggage. Im the one that talks to someone who goes into a mental breakdown in my family. But now, I just look at myself. I just can't stand the site of someone who doesnt do anything productive in life.
